service.title: The Link-Template HTTP Header Field
service.documentation: This specification defines the Link-Template HTTP header field, providing a means for describing the structure of a link between two resources so that new links can be generated.

http-header.documentation: The Link-Template header field is a Structured Field that serializes one or more links into HTTP message metadata. It is semantically equivalent to the Link header field defined in Section 3 of Web Linking, except that the link target and link anchor can contain URI Templates.
